title: Decoded messages of aliens with a dying planet needing Earth women

tellings.quote: just that there were aliens from another planet. They were here. They were trying to establish a base. They needed Earth women or something.

plain: In the early 1980s, Paul Bennewitz, an Albuquerque man who believed he was decoding alien signals, came to think that aliens from another planet were here, trying to set up a base, and that they needed Earth women. The writer Greg Bishop tells Michels this as part of Bennewitz's story, without naming a source. Bishop's point is how far these messages pulled Bennewitz into a world of his own.
